title: USS Curtis deck log luminous object

tellings.quote: the entry from the deck log of the USS Curtis the ship that detonated the hydrogen bomb at bikini at toll reads at 2305 an unidentified luminous object passed over ship from bow to stern yellowish orange in color traveling at a high rate of speed and a low altitude

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, reads out an entry from the deck log, the ship's official daily record, of the USS Curtis, which he describes as the ship that set off a hydrogen bomb test at Bikini Atoll in the Pacific in 1954. According to the entry he reads, at 11:05 at night "an unidentified luminous object passed over ship from bow to stern," yellowish orange, moving fast and low. He tells it as an example of unknown objects turning up where nuclear weapons are being tested.
